subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Majority
solution:
Here the correct answer is **Minority.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Majority"** refers to the greater number or part of something.

 
 
• For example, "The **majority **of the students in the class prefer pizza over sandwiches."
 
 
 
• **"Minority",** on the other hand, refers to the smaller number or part of something.
 
 
• For example, "The **minority **of the voters chose the third-party candidate."
 
 
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1) "Produce"** means to create or make something.

 
 
• For example, "The farmer will **produce **a bumper crop this year."
 
 
 
• **Option 2) "Matrimony"** refers to marriage.
 
 
• For example, "After years of dating, the couple finally entered into **matrimony**."
 
 
 
• **Option 3) "Adulthood"** refers to the stage of life after adolescence.
 
 
• For example, "In many cultures, people celebrate **adulthood **with a coming-of-age ceremony."
 
 
 
• None of these options are antonyms of** "Majority".**
